q: How many PRINCE2 principles are there?
a: Seven, all of which must be applied.

q: What are the seven performance targets?
a: Benefits, cost, time, quality, scope, risk and sustainability.

q: Are seven processes seven project stages?
a: No; stages are management control periods, while processes describe project activities.
A forecast breach of the tolerance delegated to a management level.

q: Does product acceptance establish all benefits?
a: No; benefits can arise and be measured after closure.
